After the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Iskalloni]] enslaved Imperial ambassodors, the Empire retaliated by launching an '''attack''' on the planet [[Iskadrell]]. The planet was half-destroyed, but the attack was repelled by the Iskalloni.
